data.name: Fleshbound Allies
data.description: You can bind the flesh of your allies to yourself by laying your hand on the ally or allies to be bound as a standard action.  Such a bond is taxing, giving you a permanent 1 point penalty to Constitution for each such bond for the duration of the bond.  While the bond exists, each fleshbound ally gains the following abilities like your familiar: share powers, speak with master, and the ability to merge with the fleshbinder.
